messages:
elaine: quick sync — launchpad marketplace + partner co-announce. need to lock press embargo, partner quote, and final landing page by EOD tomorrow.
ben: Echo — marketing needs final hero copy and 2 screenshots (console + billing flow). Can design ship morning? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya: Press request — partner legal just asked for a 48h embargo window. Is that compatible with our pipeline?
elaine: partner asked for noon PT on Tue embargo, we were targeting 9am PT. Do we want to accommodate?
marco: engineering note: marketplace listing (GCP) needs the final container image + SHA before we can set the public flag. ETA for image: tomorrow 6pm PT.
ben: Hmm — if we move embargo to noon PT, marketing can finish assets by 9am and we can stage the press release at 10. That gives partner 2h review which is tight.
priya: partner legal said they need at least 8 hours review. They can do morning review if we give them assets tonight.
elaine: ok action items: 1) ben ship hero copy + screenshots tonight 2) marco push image by 6pm 3) priya share draft PR with partner tonight 4) legal-sara loop for final legal signoff.
legal-sara: I can review the joint quote and privacy blurb tonight. Please ping me the draft PDF (no google docs) and the proposed customer-facing copy.
ben: attaching the current hero + CTA in this thread (will drop buckets link). Short preview: 
```
Redwood Inference on [Cloud Marketplace]
Deploy high-performance inference with predictable pricing and enterprise controls.
CTA: Get started — Free trial
```
marco: small integration note — the marketplace SKU must include the telemetry opt-out flag in the listing. Ops will validate.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: marketplace staging image pushed to registry at sha256:abc123... (staging).
priya: thanks marco — i'll make sure the PR mentions telemetry as optional and link to our docs. ben, can you add a short line about data residency? Partner specifically asked for EU region availability.
ben: will add: "Available in US, EU (coming soon in APAC)". keeping it short.
elaine: timeline proposal: ship assets tonight (ben), legal review complete by 10pm (legal-sara), partner review overnight, engineering final image 18:00 PT (marco), marketing staging + preview 20:00 PT, embargo set to 12:00 PT Tue. Does that work?
priya: that works if partner confirms tonight. I'll send the draft PR now with highlighted sections they must sign off on.
legal-sara: quick note — partner requires trademark usage examples. Ben pls include logo lockup + alt text.
ben: adding logo lockup and alt copy. Also creating a lightweight landing variant for partner co-brand.
marco: one more ops constraint — Azure marketplace listing has a separate validation window (can be 24-72h). We're already in queue but recommend we keep the earlier internal notice to avoid surprises.
elaine: good catch. can someone confirm Azure status?
marco: pinged our marketplace engineer on Azure; they said initial validation passed, final acceptance pending image.
priya: if Azure might delay, let's make the press release language flexible: "available on major cloud marketplaces" and call out specifics in the landing page. That avoids hard promises.
ben: agreed — short PR copy will be generic. Landing page will list exact availability badges and dates.
elaine: final checklist (quick):
```
- PR draft -> partner (priya) [tonight]
- Hero copy + screenshots (ben) [tonight]
- Logo lockup + alt text (ben) [tonight]
- Legal signoff (legal-sara) [10pm]
- Staging image pushed (marco) [6pm]
- Azure/GCP validation confirmation (marco) [by EOD]
- Landing page live on staging (marketing) [8pm]
- Press embargo set (priya/elaine) [confirmed by partner]
```
elaine: if anyone can't hit their slot, flag immediately. we will not push the announcement without either partner signoff or a hard fallback copy.
ops-bot: reminder: scheduled runbook check at 17:30 PT for marketplace release — ops team will validate telemetry and autoscaling rules.
priya: sent draft to partner with inline comments. asked for trademark examples and embargo confirmation.
ben: uploading screenshots now. sending link in DM to legal-sara for secure PDF.
marco: pushing image now. will post final sha when done.
elaine: thanks all. i'll reconvene here at 21:00 PT for a quick status tick. :thumbsup:
